name: jianying-edit
description: Native, fully editable JianYing drafts via the vendored Apache-2.0 pyJianYingDraft engine plus the built-in Rust jycut CLI: multi-track video/text/audio, the 453-name transition catalog, keyframes, masks, styled text and SRT captions; optional fork pro-tier for native export and existing-draft editing. No account, no upload.

interface.shortDescription: Edit-plan JSON to native JianYing drafts
interface.longDescription: Native, fully editable JianYing drafts via the vendored Apache-2.0 pyJianYingDraft engine plus the built-in Rust jycut CLI: multi-track video/text/audio, the 453-name transition catalog, keyframes, masks, styled text and SRT captions; optional fork pro-tier for native export and existing-draft editing. No account, no upload. Hash-pinned vendored engine; jycut adds dual-mirror writes, store registration and a verify gate.
